title: Rocky and giant planets
info: Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars are smaller rocky planets.
Jupiter and Saturn are gas giants. Uranus and Neptune are ice giants.
Venus is the hottest planet because its thick air traps heat. Saturn's rings are mostly ice.
